mapper.update: update public.employee set first_name = #{firstName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, last_name = #{lastName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, department_id = #{departmentId,jdbcType=INTEGER}, start_time = #{starttime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, end_time = #{endtime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} where id = #{id,jdbcType=INTEGER}
mapper.select: SELECT e.id, e.first_name, e.last_name, e.start_time, e.end_time, d.id AS dept_id, d.name AS dept_name, p.id AS proj_id, p.title AS proj_title, p.description AS proj_description FROM public.employee e LEFT JOIN public.department d ON e.department_id = d.id LEFT JOIN public.project_employee pe ON e.id = pe.employee_id LEFT JOIN public.project p ON pe.project_id = p.id WHERE e.id = #{id,jdbcType=INTEGER} ORDER BY e.id
